name: One&Only Royal Mirage Dubai

address.street: King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud St - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: This palatial beachfront resort feels like a Moroccan-inspired oasis where Arabian royalty once held court, complete with manicured gardens that stretch across 65 acres of prime Dubai coastline.
whats_special: The resort features three distinct villages - The Palace, Arabian Court, and Residence & Spa - each with its own character. The property boasts over 1km of private beach, traditional abra boats for romantic canal rides, and the legendary Celebrities Bar where A-listers have been spotted since the 1990s. The resort's architecture showcases authentic Moorish design with hand-painted tiles imported directly from Morocco.
pro_tip: Book a beachfront Palm Garden room for stunning sunset views, and request dinner at Al Hadheerah in the nearby Al Sahra Desert - the hotel can arrange exclusive desert transfers via vintage Land Rovers.
dont_miss: The signature afternoon tea at The Palace courtyard, a sunset camel ride along the private beach, and cocktails at the overwater Jetty Lounge. The Oriental Hammam spa treatment combines traditional Middle Eastern wellness with modern luxury, while the resort's flamingo lagoon creates an unexpectedly magical backdrop for evening strolls.
pros: Beachfront location with private beach access and stunning Arabian Gulf views
Traditional Arabian palace architecture with lush landscaped gardens
Multiple award-winning restaurants and bars offering diverse dining experiences
Luxurious spa facilities and wellness amenities for ultimate relaxation
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflecting ultra-high-end positioning
Located away from downtown Dubai attractions requiring transportation
